prepare_inputs: prepare inputs for TSM by deducing input mode and reshaping from [B,T,H,W,3] or [T*B,H,W,3] format
prepare_outputs: prepare TSM outputs by undoing the merging of batch and time dimensions with optional mean reduction
apply_temporal_shift: apply temporal shift to video features using TPU, GPU, or deflated mode with configurable channel shift fraction
temporal_shift_tpu: perform TPU-optimized temporal shift using padding and slicing to avoid reshape and concatenate operations
temporal_shift_gpu: perform GPU temporal shift using JAX lax slice and pad operations on reshaped batch-time tensors
